card.name: Digits inside decimal volumes in mL
card.fires_on: A single digit right after a decimal point in a liquid volume, usually before mL, such as 0.2 mL or 1.25 mL. Also fires on digits within other numbers.

modes.label: Decimal mL volumes
modes.description: The digit after the point in a dose volume given in mL.
modes.example: The recommended starting dosage is 2 mg (0.<<2>> mL) injected subcutaneously once daily

modes.label: Digit in other numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a year or a concentration figure.
